text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I challenge youuu!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lady SteGo, I request a duel! 
The way thou sinkest thy teeth into any 
formidable foe... 
I have long yearned to experience thy 
running for myself!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, passionate as ever. 
'Fraid I can't indulge you right now, 
though!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'm just about to head out, you see. 
Plannin' to journey as far out toward 
Kansai as my legs can take me.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. As expected of a true drifter, 
simply asking straight up won't get a nod, 
will it? 
---Then I shall take another approach!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! This monaka is delicious! 
That hit of butter makes it totally 
addictive.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, so it strikes your fancy? 
In truth, this monaka also comes in an 
exceedingly rare soy sauce flavor...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It is a limited edition, so one must make 
a mad dash 
at the break of dawn... How about it? My 
treat, so 
come tomorrow, shall we take a little run 
togeth---

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, I'm planning to head to Sapporo 
right after this. 
Well, I'll be sure to pick up a souvenir 
to thank you for the snack.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
---Hrmph, that failed too, did it? 
In that case... perhaps it is time to draw 
my secret weapon.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It seems your attendance rate has dropped 
again lately. 
You could at least show up for training 
more often...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! 
If I can use mandatory training as a 
pretext 
to drag her into a match against me---!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, eventually. 
Come on, I'll do just enough so I don't 
get expelled.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, Ste-Go-senpai...! 
...*Sigh*. Naturally, she won't listen 
that easily.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nghhh... Far more formidable than 
anticipated! 
If that is how it must be---Operation: 
Capture is a go!

One afternoon---I catch sight of a rather 
peculiar 
scene and involuntarily stop in my tracks.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, there's another carved wooden bear 
lying here! 
The last one had a gigantic salmon in its 
mouth, 
and this one's a mother and cub. How neat.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Looks like there's one over there too. 
What kind of bear will it be next~?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh... As expected, my intel regarding 
her fondness for bears was spot on!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, hush! 
I am currently executing Operation: Ste-Go 
Bait & Capture!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lure her in with carved wooden bears, then 
ambush her when her guard is down! 
And without fail, she shall face me in 
combat---

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hey, you---got quite the nerve, don't you?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...?! 
Curses, have I been discovered...?!

text_block_list.name: Thieving Crow
text_block_list.text: ---Caw, caww!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
---Wait, she is facing a crow...? 
Mmh, that crow, it is clutching some paper 
in its beak...?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Laying your claws on that... 
You must really want to learn a painful 
lesson.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hey---that plane ticket. 
I said give it back.

text_block_list.name: Thieving Crow
text_block_list.text: Gwaack... Caaaw...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho... Such overwhelming ferocity... 
Hrm, what should I do about Operation: 
Capture now?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... I gather that Lady Ste-Go shows 
no mercy 
to those who cross her... Unless the mood 
strikes her, 
she will not accept any invitation 
whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
......A temporary retreat would seem the 
wiser choice here.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Even assuming I were to pounce 
upon 
Lady Ste-Go from behind---

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ......Aye. Carnage would surely ensue.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Gaaahhhhh~~~!! 
Bitter though it is, I have no moves left 
for now---!

title: Like a Drifter on the Wind
